serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Yeah, I don’t think 100k works for me. How about 10k? It should cover the costs and still leave a nice sum for you.
Landlord: Huh? What was that?
Landlord: Oh, I’m sorry. I didn’t realize that I was dealing with a fucking wolf of Wall Street here! 
Landlord: 10k? 10k?! Do you really think this will cover my losses?! I wasn’t getting ANY money for that bathroom for a few months! 
You: W-Well, if I don’t buy it you will lose even more money…
Landlord: …
Landlord: I see where this is going. Threats. You are threatening me! You are trying to exploit my generous soul for your own benefit!
You: T-That’s not true! Why do I need to cover the losses of the bathroom not being in use?!
Landlord: And why would I pay for it?! It’s you who lives next to it! Couldn’t you notice it sooner?! 
You: That- That doesn’t make any sense!
Landlord: Oh yeah? Do you know what does make sense? That the one holding all the cards makes the rules.
Landlord: Did you honestly think you stood even the slightest chance of winning this negotiation?
Landlord: You live in my world. Do you think that only because you can afford your rent with ease we are on the same level? Don’t kid yourself!
Landlord: Because of your cheekiness, the cost of the bathroom is now 200k!
You: What?!
You: O-Ok, I will pay 100k…
Landlord: {{punch}}It’s too late for that now! You either get those 200k and agree to a 1000$ increase in the rent or you can say your own bathroom goodbye!
You: Let me think about it…
Landlord: Just don’t take too long. My patience for you is running short.
